parsed.reason: The reply says plainly that Hale can't sign her up ('past me'). It doesn't claim it did or will, and it doesn't promise to text later once sign-ups become possible. The fallback offer is valid: watch the class page for a spot if the parent sends the link. That offer only helps if the class is full, though. It misses the more fitting option for a parent who 'keeps forgetting', a calendar reminder to sign up. Solid pass, slightly less helpful than ideal.
